units: Ned. VIII, 4 (61ᵇ) עד שיקפלו המ׳ (שיקפילו, שיכפילו) up to the time when people lay the figs in layers; [oth. opin.: people fold up the knives (v. preced.) to store them away; oth. opin.: people fold up the matting on which the figs are dried before they are stored]. Ib. 62ᵃ.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 1:3">Tosef. Dem. I, 3</cite> <he>משיקפלו המַקְצָעוֹת</he>; Y. ib. I, beg. 21ᶜ <he>המקצועות</he>.
